description: Tony acts as a father figure and guiding mentor to Peter, equipping him with technology and shaping his moral responsibility.
Bantering rivalry that evolved into deep mutual respect between science and thunder across a decade of universal crises.
Unwavering loyalty starting from their morning jog in Washington DC to passing the Captain America mantle.
Unexpected comedic yet poignant friendship forged through shared loss and the quest to forge Stormbreaker.
Tony's peaceful domestic life during the five-year blip that he risked everything to protect during the Time Heist.
